facts.business: Caliber Mining and Logistics Limited provides contract mining and logistics services, primarily coal extraction and overburden removal for Coal India and its subsidiaries.

guidance_or_targets.statement: Internal target for share of Coal India's total contractual overburden removal
guidance_or_targets.metric: Share of Coal India's contractual overburden removal

key_risks: Growth and financial condition closely tied to end customer demand for contract mining and logistics services
Performance may soften during recessionary periods or when macroeconomic factors adversely affect consumer and business confidence
Aggressive bidding to win large contracts, particularly mine developer and operator contracts, is a recognised source of margin erosion in the industry

Barriers to entry include owning or commanding a fleet and maintenance capability, funding fleet before first contract award, demonstrating technical experience, and satisfying varying tender selection criteria
facts.related_party_note: Personal guarantee of all directors for borrowings; property belonging to Sutlej Strategies LLP through its Designated Partners pledged as collateral; loan from directors/relatives mentioned in maturity profile
